no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (record:pooled-situation, record:pooled-result) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep one person's noisy yes or no about a shared situation in the pool everyone learns from, under their random contributor id", and give it contributor (The person's random contributor id); situation (The shared situation's row id in pooled-situations); worked (The randomized bit, as the person's store drew it).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:add-a-pooled-result and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Runs in the account that holds the pool.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:pooled-situation (records:read); record:pooled-result (records:write).
